title: 1941 WARTIME COMMEMORATIVE LITHOGRAPH - FRAMED - SIGNED JOHN ALLCOT
findings: Colour print after John Allcot of HMAS Sydney (Captain J.A. Collins) in the action that sank the Italian cruiser Bartolomeo Colleoni in the Mediterranean, 19 July 1940. Margin inscriptions: title 'H.M.A.S. Sydney', 'From an Oil Painting by John Allcot' at right with what appears to be a pencil signature 'John Allcot', small printed note at left about the original painting being presented. Title says 1941 commemorative. Collectable Australian naval print with RAN/WWII interest; signed copies sell to militaria and marine collectors.
condition: Mat toned/foxed, gilt frame with chips and losses to corners, glass reflections; image itself looks clean.
reason: Signed John Allcot HMAS Sydney 1940 action print, collectable WWII naval Australiana.
